title: Loreweave: sixty unique rings
summary: Sixty unique rings make a Loreweave (Ornate Ringmail with three random unique-ring modifiers) through the Journey to the East quest. Cheap unique rings have buyers among players collecting sixty, and a finished Loreweave is a unique of its own to sell.

budget.why: Sixty unique rings are consumed per Loreweave.
budget.build_needs: None: collecting rings and combining them.

claim.note: Our reading of the method against the budget scale; not measured.

build.why: No combat: the method is collecting rings and trading.

claim.note: Not rated: the build scale measures map content, and this method has none.

complexity.why: The complexity scale is written for map setups, not for trading.

claim.note: Not rated: no step of the scale describes a trade loop.

durability.why_it_works: Dannig turns sixty unique rings into a Loreweave through the Journey to the East quest, so cheap unique rings have a use beyond their own mods.
breaks_when: The Loreweave recipe is removed or changed
Loreweave stops selling above sixty rings (neither is on the exchange, so no live EV)

claim.note: Our reading of the cited mechanic. Whether it pays today is only what live prices show.

inputs.text: The Journey to the East quest item (from Expedition)

claim.note: Whether duplicates of the same ring count toward the sixty is unverified.

outputs.text: Loreweave (Ornate Ringmail): fixed mods plus three random unique-ring modifiers
Or sell cheap unique rings in bulk to players collecting sixty

claim.note: Community note (だごん, 2026-06-12); its bulk prices are not repeated here.

odds.text: Sixty rings always make a Loreweave; which three unique-ring modifiers it gets is random.

steps: Keep every unique ring you find, and buy the cheapest ones in bulk on the trade site.
Get the Journey to the East quest item from Expedition and bring it to Dannig (Act 4, Ruins of Kingsmarch); give him sixty unique rings for a Loreweave.
Sell the Loreweave on the trade site, or sell your rings to a player collecting sixty.
risks: Neither the rings nor Loreweave trade on the currency exchange, so no EV is shown.
Whether duplicate rings count toward the sixty is unverified.
